notes: Fixes 'cannot find update'. The v0.23.0 release itself was fine - version.json and the APK were both live and correct - but the app could not look for it. The update repo defaulted to an empty string, so the updater gave up before making a single request, and the only sign was one line in Settings > About. Worse, the text box hinted 'owner/DWM' while the repository is actually named DWM- with a trailing hyphen, so the obvious thing to type went straight to a 404. The repo now defaults to Rivak96/DWM-, the hint shows the real value, auto-check on start is on by default, and a failed check names the repo it tried instead of just saying HTTP 404. Everything from v0.23.0 is included: the design system, the rebuilt home screen with no swipe pager, the deleted Ranger render, and the reverse parking display with steering guides.
